Develop and manage full-funnel advertising strategies covering awareness, consideration, lead generation, conversions, and retargeting. Conduct keyword research, search intent analysis, competitor analysis, and content gap analysis. Implement on-page, off-page, and technical SEO best practices. Optimize website architecture, internal linking, metadata, headings, schema markup, crawlability, indexing, and Core Web Vitals. Develop backlink acquisition and digital PR strategies to improve domain authority and search visibility. Collaborate with content writers and developers to implement SEO recommendations. Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, impressions, clicks, and conversions using Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and relevant SEO tools. 3. AEO – Answer Engine Optimization Develop strategies to improve brand visibility in AI-powered answer engines and conversational search experiences. Optimize website content to address user questions through clear answers, FAQs, structured information, and authoritative content. Build topical authority through expert-led articles, comparison pages, how-to guides, and question-based content. Implement relevant structured data and schema markup to help search engines understand website content. Monitor brand visibility and citations across eligible answer-oriented search experiences where measurement is available. Align content with conversational queries, natural-language searches, and intent-driven discovery. 4. GEO – Generative Engine Optimization Develop and implement strategies to improve brand discoverability across generative AI search and answer platforms. Optimize content for potential inclusion, citation, and mentions in AI-generated responses across platforms such as ChatGPT search, Google AI Overviews, and Perplexity. Strengthen brand authority through original research, credible information, expert content, industry mentions, and relevant third-party references. Create structured, factually accurate, and context-rich content that generative systems can interpret and reference. Audit brand presence, competitor visibility, and citation opportunities across AI-driven discovery channels. Track available indicators of AI-referred traffic, brand mentions, citations, and assisted conversions without relying on unsupported ranking guarantees. 5. Organic Growth & Content Strategy Develop an integrated organic growth strategy across search engines, social media, website content, and relevant online communities. Plan and manage content calendars for blogs, landing pages, social media, videos, case studies, and other digital assets. Drive organic reach, engagement, website visits, inbound inquiries, and qualified leads. Work closely with content creators, designers, video editors, and subject-matter experts to produce high-performing content. Identify growth opportunities through competitor benchmarking, audience research, trend analysis, and content performance data. Build repeatable growth experiments to improve reach, engagement, conversion, and retention. 6. Website Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Optimize landing pages, website journeys, forms, CTAs, and lead capture mechanisms to improve conversion rates. Conduct A/B testing on headlines, creatives, landing pages, forms, and user journeys. Identify friction points using analytics, heatmaps, session recordings, and funnel analysis where available. Collaborate with design and development teams to implement conversion improvements. Ensure campaigns direct users to relevant landing pages aligned with the advertised offer and search intent. 7. Analytics, Attribution & Reporting Set up and maintain marketing measurement using Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, Meta Pixel, and relevant conversion APIs. Configure conversion events, lead tracking, campaign tagging, and UTM parameters. Build dashboards and reports covering channel performance, marketing spend, leads, qualified leads, conversions, and revenue contribution. Analyze campaign and funnel data to identify inefficiencies and growth opportunities. Coordinate with the sales team to track lead quality, lead-to-customer conversion, and marketing-generated revenue. Present actionable performance reports, insights, and recommendations to management. 8. Marketing Strategy & Team Leadership Develop quarterly and monthly digital marketing plans aligned with business growth targets. Allocate budgets across paid acquisition, organic growth, content, SEO, and emerging discovery channels. Coordinate with sales, product, design, technology, and business development teams. Manage external agencies, freelancers, and marketing vendors wherever required. Establish campaign processes, reporting standards, experimentation frameworks, and performance benchmarks. Stay updated on advertising platform changes, search algorithm updates, privacy requirements, and emerging AI-driven marketing trends. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field. MBA in Marketing or a relevant digital marketing certification is an added advantage. 4–7 years of hands-on experience in digital marketing, including substantial ownership of paid campaigns and organic growth initiatives. Demonstrated experience managing advertising budgets and delivering measurable business results. Strong practical understanding of SEO, AEO, GEO, performance marketing, conversion optimization, and marketing analytics. *Location:* Hyderabad *Industry:* Hospitality / Resorts / Weddings & Conventions *Experience:* 3 to 6 Years *Employment Type:* Full-Time 
 ### About the Role 
 We are looking for a *Performance Marketing Manager* who can take complete ownership of our digital lead-generation activities and performance marketing ecosystem. 
 The candidate will be responsible for planning, executing, monitoring and optimizing campaigns across *Meta, Facebook, Instagram, Google, YouTube and other relevant digital platforms, with a strong focus on generating **high-quality, conversion-oriented leads* for our resort, weddings, banquets, conventions and hospitality business. 
 This role requires someone who understands that *generating leads is only the beginning* the real objective is to generate the right leads, track their quality, analyse performance and continuously improve campaigns based on business outcomes. 
 ### Key Responsibilities 
 *1. Lead Generation & Campaign Management* 
 * Plan and execute lead-generation campaigns across Meta, Facebook, Instagram, Google and YouTube. * Manage campaigns from campaign planning to execution, optimization and reporting. * Develop strategies for generating leads for: 
 * Weddings & Events * Banquets * Conventions * Corporate Events * Resort Bookings * Staycation / Leisure * Other business requirements * Continuously monitor *lead volume, lead quality, cost per lead and conversion performance*. * Identify underperforming campaigns and take corrective action. 
 *2. Meta & Google Ads* 
 * Manage Meta Ads campaigns including Facebook and Instagram. * Manage Google Ads including Search, Display, Performance Max and other relevant campaigns. * Plan and manage YouTube advertising campaigns. * Conduct audience research, targeting, retargeting and remarketing. * Manage campaign budgets and optimize ad spend for maximum ROI. 
 *3. Lead Inflow & Tracking* 
 * Take ownership of the complete *digital lead inflow*. * Ensure leads are properly captured, categorized and transferred to the sales team. * Monitor lead sources and campaign-wise performance. * Coordinate with the sales team to understand: 
 * Valid leads * Invalid leads * Duplicate leads * Unresponsive leads * Qualified leads * Converted leads * Analyse why leads are not converting and recommend corrective strategies. 
 *4. Performance Analysis & Reporting* Prepare regular reports covering: 
 * Total leads generated * Platform-wise leads * Campaign-wise leads * Cost Per Lead (CPL) * Qualified / Valid Leads * Lead-to-Booking Conversion * Campaign ROI / ROAS * Ad Spend * Website performance * Enquiry trends * Audience performance * Month-on-month performance 
 Reports should provide *insights and actionable recommendations*, not just numbers. 
 *5. Strategy & Optimization* 
 * Develop monthly and quarterly digital marketing strategies. * Identify new target audiences and market opportunities. * Analyse competitor campaigns and market trends. * Recommend new campaigns, offers, creatives and targeting strategies. * Conduct A/B testing of creatives, audiences, copy and landing pages. * Continuously optimize campaigns to improve lead quality and reduce acquisition costs. 
 *6. Website, Landing Pages & Tracking* 
 * Coordinate with the website/development team for landing pages and conversion optimization. * Monitor website enquiries, forms, WhatsApp enquiries and other digital conversion points. * Ensure proper tracking through relevant analytics and conversion-tracking tools. * Identify gaps in the customer journey from *Ad Lead Sales Follow-up Booking*. 
 *7. Creative & Content Coordination* 
 * Work closely with graphic designers, video editors and content teams. * Provide clear briefs for: 
 * Ad creatives * Reels * Videos * Banners * Campaign-specific content * Offers and promotional campaigns * Analyse creative performance and recommend what type of content should be produced. 
 *8. Sales Team Coordination* 
 * Work closely with the Sales Head and sales team. * Share campaign performance and lead-quality reports. * Take feedback from the sales team regarding lead quality. * Compare marketing-generated leads with actual sales outcomes. * Identify gaps between *lead generation and lead conversion*. * Use sales feedback to improve future campaigns. 
 ### Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 The candidate will be evaluated on: 
 *LEAD GENERATION LEAD QUALITY CPL QUALIFIED LEADS SALES FOLLOW-UP CONVERSION ROI* 
 Key KPIs include: 
 * Quality of leads generated * Cost per qualified lead * Lead-to-conversion ratio * Campaign ROI / ROAS * Reduction in wasted ad spend * Growth in qualified enquiries * Campaign performance improvement * Accuracy and timeliness of reporting 
 ### Required Skills 
 * Strong knowledge of *Meta Ads Manager* * Strong knowledge of *Google Ads* * Facebook & Instagram advertising * YouTube advertising * Google Analytics / GA4 * Conversion tracking & pixels * Remarketing / retargeting * Audience segmentation * Lead-generation funnels * Campaign analytics * Excel / Google Sheets * Performance reporting * Basic understanding of landing-page optimization * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills 
 ### Ideal Candidate 
 We are looking for someone who is: 
 * *Data-driven* * Highly analytical * Result-oriented * Strong in campaign optimization * Comfortable working with numbers and reports * Able to identify problems independently * Able to coordinate with sales and creative teams * Proactive in suggesting new strategies * Focused on *business results, not just lead numbers*
